_comment: Starter routes: only the CLIs Paseo detects itself (codex, claude). Nothing is pre-configured: add every other provider (Qwen Code, Qoder, other accounts...) in Settings > Providers or with `agent-hub provider add --routes code-edit,summarise:1`, which also puts it into these chains. An empty chain answers: no provider configured for <type>: add one in Settings > Providers. Entries may be latest aliases (codex/latest[-sol|-terra], claude/latest-opus|sonnet|haiku, qoder/<tier>@latest) resolved at dispatch; see plugins/routing/resolve.mjs. A busy or failed entry moves to the next one. Copy to routes.local.json and replace <REPO_GATE_COMMAND> and the gate rows.
